name: Tum Sath Ho Ya Na Ho Kya Fark Hai
visual_description: Deepika Padukone consoling a distressed Ranbir Kapoor with her hand on his head, from the song Agar Tum Saath Ho in Tamasha.
usage_context: Used to express feelings of apathy, heartbreak, helplessness, or when someone's support doesn't change a ruined situation.

example.top_text: When your friend sends notes 5 minutes before the exam

text_areas.description: Situation or setup highlighting futility, depression, or indifference
